segments.ja134:1.1: Ye saññino tepi duggatā, yepi asaññino tepi duggatā;
segments.ja134:1.3: Etaṃ ubhayaṃ vivajjaya, taṃ samāpattisukhaṃ anaṅgaṇanti.

lines: Tattha ye saññinoti ṭhapetvā nevasaññānāsaññāyatanalābhino avasese sacittakasatte dasseti.
Tepi duggatāti tassā samāpattiyā alābhato tepi duggatā nāma.
Tepi duggatāti tepi imissāyeva samāpattiyā alābhato duggatāyeva nāma.
Etaṃ ubhayaṃ vivajjayāti etaṃ ubhayampi saññibhavañca asaññibhavañca vivajjaya pajahāti antevāsikaṃ ovadati.
Taṃ samāpattisukhaṃ anaṅgaṇanti taṃ nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasamāpattilābhino santaṭṭhena “sukhan”ti saṅkhaṃ gataṃ jhānasukhaṃ anaṅgaṇaṃ niddosaṃ balavacittekaggatāsabhāvenapi taṃ anaṅgaṇaṃ nāma jātaṃ.
